summary.text: Darci Smith is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 37A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Tom McKee in a race with no incumbent.
A real estate agent, she says she has a background in sales and executive roles and is running on affordability.

paragraphs.text: Darci Smith earned a high school diploma from Roosevelt High School and works as a real estate agent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Smith described herself as a working-class bonus mom to special-needs children who built skills in advocacy and negotiation through sales and real estate.
She wrote that she is the daughter of a factory worker and veteran and a secretary, and that her family went into bankruptcy after her mother was diagnosed with breast cancer when Smith was 17.
Smith said she wants to make government more efficient without raising the cost of living, and to close loopholes for the wealthy to fund affordability measures.
